description: Introduce an explicit household balance policy so Pulse can prefer Plaid available balances for depository cash views while preserving current balances as ledger values. Add a household setting, centralize balance selection logic, and align dashboard/accounts/kids/coverage calculations with the selected basis.

timing.gatingCondition: None. Feature 12 (Liability Coverage) is already shipped and provides one of the key downstream consumers of depository balance policy.

principles: Separate spendable cash from ledger balance — one number cannot serve both meanings reliably
Default to available balance when Plaid provides it for depository accounts, because that most closely matches real spendable cash
Never hand-net pending transactions to override the institution's balance view when available_balance is present
Ledger balance remains visible and queryable — this is not a destructive replacement of current_balance
Non-depository accounts keep existing semantics unless explicitly expanded later
Balance policy must be centralized in one helper/module so routes and UIs do not drift
Household setting controls behavior globally; kids and parents should see consistent policy-driven balances

techStack.testing: node:test for policy helpers, API aggregates, and settings persistence

userStories.title: Centralize depository balance selection policy
acceptanceCriteria: New shared helper/module defines display balance selection rules
Mode available_preferred returns available_balance for depository accounts when non-null, otherwise falls back to current_balance
Helper exposes both account-level selection and aggregate summation helpers
Credit, loan, and investment accounts retain existing current_balance behavior unless explicitly overridden
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests for account-level and aggregate selection across mixed available/current/null inputs.

userStories.title: Add household balance policy setting
acceptanceCriteria: app_config stores balance_basis with allowed values available_preferred and current_only
Default behavior is available_preferred when config is unset
Settings page exposes a clear household-level toggle with explanatory copy
Settings save path persists the chosen basis and reflects the current selection on reload
userStories.testStrategy: Integration test for config default and persistence plus manual settings UI verification.

userStories.title: Use policy-driven balances in household and kid cash views
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard liquid total and net cash view use the configured balance basis for depository accounts
Accounts page depository account cards use the configured main balance and can show ledger balance as secondary detail when mode is available_preferred
Kids dashboard total balance uses the configured balance basis
Balance labels in the UI clarify whether the displayed number is Available or Ledger when needed
No change to transaction history or transfer-detection logic
userStories.testStrategy: API and UI verification using accounts where available_balance differs from current_balance.

userStories.title: Align coverage and other depository aggregates with policy
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage calculator uses configured balance basis for depository total
Kid-linked account exclusion still applies before summation
Coverage status changes correctly when available_balance materially differs from current_balance
Any future aggregate helper consumers can reuse the same policy module
userStories.testStrategy: Coverage integration tests for available-preferred vs current-only scenarios.

medium: Institutions do not populate available_balance consistently, so fallback behavior must be explicit and tested
Users may be surprised if top-line balances change after enabling available_preferred; UI labeling must make the basis obvious
Coverage alerts may become more conservative under available_preferred, which is correct but behaviorally visible
low: A single global household setting may eventually be less flexible than per-user preference, but is the right MVP tradeoff

preFlightChecklist: Confirm current UI locations that show depository balances: dashboard, accounts, kids, coverage
Confirm app_config read/write pattern to reuse from existing settings features
Decide whether to show secondary ledger balance inline or only in a tooltip/subtext when available_preferred is active
Verify at least one real/sandbox account has available_balance different from current_balance for end-to-end validation
